post.description: Requires academics.write with school scope, same-origin/CSRF and live session. School overrides take priority over national_holiday/joint_leave, then schedule weekdays. Existing open sessions and attendance are preserved. Fetches a fixed public provider with timeout/size limits outside school locks, reauthorizes and audits atomically before persistence. Empty/invalid/unavailable responses preserve the last cache and return 503 HOLIDAYS_UNAVAILABLE. Simultaneous sync returns 409.

checkout_start.description: Local HH:mm start of automatic checkout; after cutoff plus grace and before close_time. Empty input disables checkout. Missing input preserves legacy check-in-only behavior; PATCH omission preserves current value. Existing sessions keep their snapshots.

check_in_local.description: Alternative to check_in_at; interpreted in the session timezone. Exactly one timestamp for present/late.
